scope: Independent read-only spec-then-quality review of frozen native A sticky-cancel follow-up and B asynchronous next-source preparation in the isolated qq-task14-streaming tree. No build, application/QQ execution, Git/source modification, or account/profile/cache access. Existing standalone test executables used with synthetic fixtures only.
result: No open P0-P2 findings in the frozen reviewed slice. Integration with the user's existing DSP changes, rebuilding/packaging the application, and real QQ/Twilight playback acceptance remain separate root-owned work.
pinVerification: Independently recomputed all 11 entries of isolated-tree .cache/qq-task14-native-service-source-pins.json; all matched. The source manifest explicitly covers the slice before integration with user DSP baseline.

specCompliance.requirement: Starting the current song and acknowledging play must not wait for the next source's HTTP open/probe.
specCompliance.observed: One owned PreloadJob runs next-source open/configure/start on its worker. The accepted call does not wait for that new worker. Both gapless-off and gapless-on held-next-open fixtures acknowledged play within 500 ms, started current output and advanced current position. Cancellation/join of a previous preparation can still delay a replacement command until cooperative cancellation completes.

specCompliance.requirement: Stop, clear, replacement, seek, output edits and source promotion must reject stale asynchronous preparation.
specCompliance.observed: A single preload revision plus current routing token guards publication. The first withdrawal captures acceptedRevision and acceptedSourceToken; the second mutex section after joining the old worker synchronizes promotion and validates both again before preparing a new worker. Publication revalidates revision, cancellation and source token. Pending same-request deduplication also requires its bound current-source token to match.

specCompliance.requirement: Seek/output reconfiguration must preserve an authoritative still-requested next song without resurrecting old queue state.
specCompliance.observed: Seek and output completion re-arm from the existing pending owner with an expected source token and revision. A newer queue replacement or clear wins. Forced resetPreloadOverlap uses one guarded submission instead of a clear-then-submit window. When a completed old worker observes only source-token mismatch, its authoritative pending tuple remains available to the seek control owner; it cannot deduplicate a request against the new current token.

specCompliance.requirement: Pure DSP edits must not silently cancel the next preparation that Play has just accepted.
specCompliance.observed: Config, graph and transactional DSP edits preserve pending preparation when gapless remains enabled. The worker publishes using the latest DSP configuration while under the existing pipeline mutex. Gapless disable, actual transport/output changes and generation checks still invalidate as appropriate.

specCompliance.requirement: No join under the pipeline or engine state mutex, no callback-token UAF, and no new render-thread lock.
specCompliance.observed: preloadControlMutex serializes one prepare/launch/join slot; joins occur outside pipeline mutex_. Existing engine call sites leave their state mutex before preload/retirement calls. The preload worker can therefore acquire pipeline mutex_ to discard stale work while its control owner joins. A published DecodeStream owns the shared cancellation token and declares it before its decoder so token destruction follows decoder destruction. Job release uses token-specific compare/exchange and cannot release a newer token. DecodeStream shared-pointer deletion goes through the existing reaper. This slice adds no mutex acquisition to the render callback.

specCompliance.requirement: Accepted asynchronous work must remain distinct from readiness or a format guarantee.
specCompliance.observed: preloadNext true means submission accepted/deduplicated, not ready. preloadReady and later status describe completion. Stop/destruction cancel and join the owned job before tearing down engine-owned state.

specCompliance.requirement: The native A after-join restart must clear cancellation state while retaining real network failures.
specCompliance.observed: readFailureWasCancelled classifies the sticky failure. Restart clears that cancellation-classified failure plus AVIO cancelled/error EOF state when the owned cancel flag was set, while genuine network timeout/read failures stay sticky. The earlier P2 is closed; exact frame-position recovery still requires the caller to seek/reposition.

reviewCounterexamplesResolvedBeforeFreez: Pure DSP edit immediately after Play cancelled pending next preparation without rearming it; covered by all three DSP-edit paths.
Seek and output change cancelled an unpublished pending next song and then searched only the published preload; covered by same-next rearm tests.
Old upcoming captured before a blocked seek overwrote a newer queue replacement or clear; covered by both deterministic variants.
Source-token mismatch completion cleared authoritative pending intent before seek could reuse it; pending binding and publication rules now preserve the right owner.

The first guarded submission could join an old worker while seek/promotion changed current generation, then launch stale work against the new current; acceptedRevision plus acceptedSourceToken are now rechecked after join, with a deterministic held-cancellation regression.

preloadNarrow.observed: Gapless off/on current output starts and acknowledges while next open is held; stop/clear/replace/seek/output cancel exits in approximately 10.7-12.4 ms in synthetic gates with no stale publication; seek/output rearm, three DSP edits, queue replacement/clear during seek and generation change during join pass.

pcmFailureNarrow.observed: Failure drain without next promotion, one-time error, retirement acknowledgement, finite high-rate HTTP preroll, queue worker revocation, EOF preroll and raw typed gapless preservation pass.

realFfmpegCancelRestart.observed: Blocked HTTP read was cancelled, joined and restarted; after-restart decoded frames 1536000, error false and true EOF. Total 1916928 frames versus 1920000 for an uninterrupted fixture is explicitly not frame-exact recovery.

realFfmpegHealthyProgressBeyondIdleBudge.observed: A synthetic HTTP WAV sends an initial burst and then 256 KiB per second. Decode lasts 24197.3 ms, produces all 1920000 frames, true EOF, no error/timeout and no parent kill. This independently checks that continuing byte progress survives longer than the 15-second idle budget.

existingDiagnosticLimitation.detail: The historical lastPreloadFormatMismatch_ flag and format_mismatch public reason are an umbrella for failed next-source preparation. In the initial frozen A snapshot, openSource failure at lines 4496-4501, configure failure and DSP-graph preparation failure already set this flag. The architecture documentation explicitly described sticky format_mismatch for preload failure. B preserves that enum rather than proving every such failure is a codec/output-format incompatibility. A network/open timeout can therefore have this legacy status; consumers must not infer the actual failure cause or automatically downgrade quality from the string alone. Asynchronous true is acceptance, so it also cannot be treated as a successful preload.

limits: Native narrow preload fixtures use deterministic fake decoder/backend gates; they prove the ownership contract within that harness, not arbitrary network cancellation latency or real-device behavior.

FFmpeg deadlines are cooperative IO interruption budgets. They do not establish a hard wall-clock bound for arbitrary DNS, OS, codec, plugin or filesystem work that never invokes the interrupt callback.

HTTP read idle budget resets on bytes_read progress, not decoded PCM progress. A clean chunked response ending early may be true transport EOF even when content metadata advertises more audio; proxy range/length checks remain necessary.
This review neither rebuilds nor packages the installed application, and it does not claim original QQ cache exclusion, P2P use, native publication, or real-song stutter resolution.
The root's actual same-song/quality cache-controlled and long-duration playback measurements remain the acceptance evidence for the user-visible result.

subsequentReviewQualification.laterFinding: The subsequent full performance gate exposed a pending-preload eligibility P2 when changing AutoMix from off while a next open was in flight. It was not covered by this older five-function narrow run. The final source slice adds invalidation and guarded rearm on actual mode changes plus a deterministic held-open regression.
